1220923097991340032.a: ICE car production spends about twice as much on chassis, safety systems, and drivetrain over an EV. The only manufacturing cost disadvantage today for an EV is the battery pack versus a tank to store fuel. Everything else can be made so much simpler and yet still improve safety.

1220923099065004032.a: Which also highlights why taking an ICE car and just slapping an EV powertrain into it does not make an economical vehicle to produce. You have all that hardening against the engine crushing you and preventing fireballs of gas fumes from erupting which is just not there in an EV.
